@@@START_FILE@@@
ServerRoot "/usr/local/apache2"
PidFile "/var/www/httpd.pid"

Listen 80

LoadModule mpm_event_module modules/mod_mpm_event.so
LoadModule authn_core_module modules/mod_authn_core.so
LoadModule authz_host_module modules/mod_authz_host.so
LoadModule authz_user_module modules/mod_authz_user.so
LoadModule authz_core_module modules/mod_authz_core.so
LoadModule authnz_ldap_module modules/mod_authnz_ldap.so
LoadModule ldap_module modules/mod_ldap.so
LoadModule auth_basic_module modules/mod_auth_basic.so
LoadModule reqtimeout_module modules/mod_reqtimeout.so
LoadModule filter_module modules/mod_filter.so
LoadModule mime_module modules/mod_mime.so
LoadModule log_config_module modules/mod_log_config.so
LoadModule env_module modules/mod_env.so
LoadModule headers_module modules/mod_headers.so
LoadModule setenvif_module modules/mod_setenvif.so
LoadModule unixd_module modules/mod_unixd.so
LoadModule dir_module modules/mod_dir.so
LoadModule ssl_module modules/mod_ssl.so

ServerTokens Prod
ServerSignature Off
FileETag None
TraceEnable Off
Timeout 60
MaxRequestWorkers 100
KeepAliveTimeout 5
RequestReadTimeout header=20-40,MinRate=500 body=20,MinRate=500

<IfModule unixd_module>
    User www-data
    Group www-data
</IfModule>

ServerAdmin security@example.com
DocumentRoot "/var/www/"

<Directory />
    Options None
    AllowOverride None
    Require all denied
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/">
    Options None
    AllowOverride None
    Require all denied
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/website1">
    Options None
    AllowOverride None
    AuthType Basic
    AuthName "LDAP Authentication"
    AuthBasicProvider ldap
    AuthLDAPURL "ldap://ldap.example.com/dc=example,dc=com?uid?sub?(objectClass=*)"
    Require valid-user
    <LimitExcept GET POST OPTIONS>
        Require all denied
    </LimitExcept>
</Directory>

<Directory "/var/www/website2">
    Options None
    AllowOverride None
    AuthType Basic
    AuthName "LDAP Authentication"
    AuthBasicProvider ldap
    AuthLDAPURL "ldap://ldap.example.com/dc=example,dc=com?uid?sub?(objectClass=*)"
    Require valid-user
    <LimitExcept GET POST OPTIONS>
        Require all denied
    </LimitExcept>
</Directory>

<Files ".ht*">
    Require all denied
</Files>

ErrorLog /proc/self/fd/2
LogLevel warn
EnableSendfile Off

<IfModule log_config_module>
    LogFormat "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b \"%{Referer}i\" \"%{User-Agent}i\"" combined
    LogFormat "%h %l %u %t \"%r\" %>s %b" common
    CustomLog /proc/self/fd/1 combined
</IfModule>

<IfModule headers_module>
    Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    Header set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
    Header set X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block"
    Header set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
    Header set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self';"
    Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    Header unset Server
    Header unset X-Powered-By
    RequestHeader unset Proxy early
</IfModule>

<IfModule mime_module>
    TypesConfig conf/mime.types
    AddType application/x-compress .Z
    AddType application/x-gzip .gz .tgz
    AddDefaultCharset UTF-8
</IfModule>

LDAPTrustedGlobalCert CA_BASE64 /path/to/ldap-ca.pem

Listen 443
<VirtualHost *:443>
    ServerName example.com
    DocumentRoot "/var/www"
    SSLEngine on
    SSLCertificateFile /path/to/cert.pem
    SSLCertificateKeyFile /path/to/key.pem
    SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3
    SSLCipherSuite ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384
    SSLHonorCipherOrder on
    SSLCompression off
    SSLSessionTickets off
    SSLUseStapling on
    SSLStaplingCache "shmcb:logs/stapling-cache(150000)"
</VirtualHost>
@@@END_FILE@@@

@@@START_FILE@@@
    - name: Update Tomcat to fix CVE-2020-1938
      yum:
        name: tomcat9
        state: latest

    - name: Stop Tomcat service
      service:
        name: tomcat9
        state: stopped

    - name: Remove AJP connector
      copy:
        dest: /etc/tomcat9/server.xml
        content: |
          <?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
          <Server port="8005" shutdown="SHUTDOWN">
            ...
          </Server>

    - name: Create AJP connector with security constraints
      copy:
        dest: /etc/tomcat9/conf/web.xml
        content: |
          <?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
          <web-app xmlns="http://java.sun.com/xml/ns/javaee" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://java.sun.com/xml/ns/javaee http://java.sun.com/xml/ns/javaee/web-app_3_0.xsd" version="3.0">
            <security-constraint>
              <display-name>AJP Security Constraint</display-name>
              <web-resource-collection>
                <web-resource-name>AJP Connector</web-resource-name>
                <url-pattern>/ajp/*</url-pattern>
              </web-resource-collection>
              <auth-constraint>
                <role-name>manager-gui</role-name>
              </auth-constraint>
            </security-constraint>
          </web-app>

    - name: Restart Tomcat service
      service:
        name: tomcat9
        state: restarted

    - name: Ensure Tomcat is running
      service:
        name: tomcat9
        state: started

    - name: Check Tomcat version
      command: tomcat9 --version
      register: tomcat_version

    - name: Fail if Tomcat version is not updated
      fail:
        msg: "Tomcat version did not update to fix CVE-2020-1938"
      when: tomcat_version.exit_code != 0

    - name: Check AJP connector is removed
      stat:
        path: /etc/tomcat9/server.xml
        regexp: '<Connector'
      register: ajp_connector_status

    - name: Fail if AJP connector is not removed
      fail:
        msg: "AJP connector was not removed"
      when: ajp_connector_status.stat != 0

    - name: Check web.xml file has security constraints for AJP connector
      stat:
        path: /etc/tomcat9/conf/web.xml
        regexp: '<security-constraint>'
      register: webxml_status

    - name: Fail if web.xml file does not have security constraints for AJP connector
      fail:
        msg: "Security constraints for AJP connector were not added to web.xml"
      when: webxml_status.stat != 0

    - name: Check Tomcat is running
      service:
        name: tomcat9
        state: started
      register: tomcat_running

    - name: Fail if Tomcat is not running
      fail:
        msg: "Tomcat is not running"
      when: tomcat_running.stat == 0

@@@END_FILE@@@

---
- hosts: all
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Update packages
      apt:
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Install OpenJDK
      apt:
        name: openjdk-8-jre
        state: present

    - name: Download Tomcat9 tarball
      get_url:
        url: https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/pub/linux/tomcat/tomcat9/v9.0.62/tomcat-9.0.62.tar.gz
        dest: /tmp/tomcat-9.0.62.tar.gz

    - name: Extract Tomcat tarball
      tar:
        src: /tmp/tomcat-9.0.62.tar.gz
        dest: /opt/tomcat
        xdir: yes

    - name: Set Tomcat ownership and permissions
      file:
        path: /opt/tomcat
        owner: tomcat
        group: tomcat
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Create Tomcat service
      copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/tomcat.service
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Apache Tomcat Web Application Container
          After=network.target

          [Service]
          User=tomcat
          Group=tomcat
          WorkingDirectory={{ tomcat_path }}
          ExecStart={{ tomcat_path }}/bin/startup.sh
          ExecStop={{ tomcat_path }}/bin/shutdown.sh
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=10
          LimitNOFILE=64
          EnvironmentFile={{ tomcat_path }}/bin/setenv.sh
          StandardOutput=syslog
          StandardError=syslog
          SyslogIdentifier=tomcat

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target

    - name: Reload systemd manager configuration
      systemd:
        name: tomcat
        state: reloaded

    - name: Start Tomcat service
      systemd:
        name: tomcat
        enabled: yes
        state: started

fields.content:
Here's a breakdown of the roles and permissions for each group in your file:

1. **Administrator (dev005)**: Has full ownership over Reporting, Finance, and Metrics sections. This user can make any changes to these areas.

2. **Developer (dev006, dev007, dev008, dev009, dev010, dev011, dev012, dev013, dev014, dev015, dev016, dev017)**: Can maintain the Webentwicklung, Appentwicklung, and Integration sections. They also have read-only access to the Reporting, Finance, and Metrics sections. This group can make changes within their assigned areas but cannot modify the higher-level data in other sections.

3. **Reporter (dev011, dev012, dev013, dev014, dev015, dev016, dev017)**: Can report on the Integration section but does not have full maintenance rights. They can view and analyze data in this area but cannot make changes to it.

4. **Quality Assurance (qa001, qa002)**: Can maintain all sections (Webentwicklung, Appentwicklung, Integration, Reporting, Finance, Metrics). This group is responsible for ensuring the quality of data and functionality across the entire system. They can make changes to correct any issues they find during their testing processes.

5. **Maintenance (bot007)**: Maintains the Metrics section. It's unclear if this user has other permissions or roles within the system.

This breakdown of roles and permissions helps ensure that each group has the necessary access to perform their tasks while maintaining proper data integrity and security throughout the system.

1. **Developers** (dev06, dev07, dev08, dev09, dev010, dev011, dev012, dev013, dev014, dev015, dev016, dev017): These users have the ability to maintain and make changes to the codebase. They also have reporter-level access to the Integration module, which allows them to submit reports or updates related to that module.

2. **Reporters** (dev011, dev012, dev013, dev014, dev015, dev016, dev017): These users can submit reports or updates to the Integration module due to their reporter-level access. They do not have the same level of control as developers over the codebase.

3. **Finance Developers** (dev014, dev015, dev016, dev017): These users have additional permissions in the Finanzen module, allowing them to work on its development alongside their role as Integration reporters.

4. **Quality Assurance (QA) Testers** (qa001, qa002): These users have maintainers-level access to all modules (Webentwicklung, Appentwicklung, Integration, Reporting, Finanzen, Metriken). This means they can review, test, and make necessary changes in each module.

5. **Maintainers (Bot007)**: This user has maintainers-level access to the Metriken module. Their role may include ensuring its smooth operation, troubleshooting issues, and making improvements when needed.

6. **Other Roles**: The roles of bot007 and @@@END_FILE@@@ are unclear from the provided data. It is essential to gather more information about their intended function within the system for accurate role identification.

@@@START_FILE@@@

# Default Policy
INPUT_POLICY=$(iptables -P INPUT DROP)
OUTPUT_POLICY=$(iptables -P OUTPUT DROP)
FORWARD_POLICY=$(iptables -P FORWARD DROP)

# Internal Network Rules (Internal to Internet)
# Allow ICMP from internal network to internet
iptables -A INPUT -s 10.0.0.0/16 -p icmp -j ACCEPT

# Redirect all traffic destined for internet to Application Proxy
iptables -A FORWARD -d wan0 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j DNAT --to-destination 172.16.20.50
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -p tcp -o wan0 -d 172.16.20.50 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j SNAT --to-source 172.16.20.50

# Allow internal traffic to DMZ (except DMZ to Internal)
iptables -A INPUT -s 10.0.0.0/16 !d 172.16.20.0/24 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A FORWARD -s 10.0.0.0/16 !d 172.16.20.0/24 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 172.16.20.0/24 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j REJECT

# DMZ Rules (DMZ to Internet)
# Allow established connections from DMZ to internet
iptables -A FORWARD -m state --established,Related -j ACCEPT

# DMZ Server Exceptions
# Webservers communicate only with Load Balancer VIP
iptables -A INPUT -d 172.16.20.10,172.16.20.11 -p tcp --dport 80,443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A FORWARD -d 172.16.20.100,172.16.20.50 -s 172.16.20.10,172.16.20.11 -p tcp --dport 80,443 -j ACCEPT
# Allow Webservers to respond on their own ports
iptables -A FORWARD -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -d 172.16.20.10,172.16.20.11 -j ACCEPT
# Allow all traffic to Load Balancer VIP and Application Proxy (excluding incoming web traffic)
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -d 172.16.20.100 --dport !80,443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -d 172.16.20.50 --dport !80,443 -j ACCEPT
# Allow all traffic from DMZ to Management Network for RDP and SSH
iptables -A FORWARD -s 172.16.20.0/24 -d 10.1.0.0/24 -p tcp --dport 3389,22 -j ACCEPT

# Management Network Rules (Management to DMZ)
# Allow RDP and SSH from Management Network to DMZ
iptables -A INPUT -s 10.1.0.0/24 -p tcp --dport 3389,22 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A FORWARD -s 10.1.0.0/24 -d 172.16.20.0/24 -p tcp --dport 3389,22 -j ACCEPT

# Restore default policies
iptables -P INPUT $INPUT_POLICY
iptables -P OUTPUT $OUTPUT_POLICY
iptables -P FORWARD $FORWARD_POLICY

   @@@END_FILE@@@

- name: Mitigate CVE-2021-44228 vulnerability
  hosts: all
  tasks:
    - name: Find all JAR files
      find:
        paths: /srv/app/
        patterns: "*.jar"
      register: jar_files

    - name: Check for log4j jar files
      set_fact:
        log4j_files: "{{ jar_files.files | selectattr('path', 'search', 'log4j') | list }}"

    - name: Disable JNDI in log4j2 by setting JVM flag

        create: yes

        insertafter: EOF
      when: log4j_files | length > 0

    - name: Restart application to apply JVM flag
      shell: systemctl restart app.service
      when: log4j_files | length > 0

---
- name: Fix CVE-2020-1938 Vulnerability
  hosts: tomcat-server

  tasks:
    - name: Disable AJP Port to fix vulnerability
      shell: echo "Listen backlog = 65536" >> /etc/tomcat9/server.xml
      when: ansible_kernel == 'Linux'
    
    - name: Configure Tomcat to use HTTP over port 8443 instead of AJP
      template:
        src: templates/tomcat.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/tomcat7/server.xml
    
    - name: Upgrade Catalina from tomcat7 to tomcat9
      package:
        state: absent
        name: tomcat7
      
      - name: Add repositories for newer Tomcats  
        yum_repository:
          name: oracle-tomcat 
          mirrorlist: [http://download.oracle.com/otn_software/tomcat/$releasever/tomcat-9-x86_64-pkg](http://download.oracle.com/otn_software/tomcat/$releasever/tomcat-9-x86_64-pkg)
      
      - name: Install tomcat package
        yum:
          name: "oracle-tomcat8 java-1.8.0-openjdk-oracle-headless java-1.7.0_openjdk-oracle-headless"
          state: latest
    
    - name: Update server.xml configuration to use Tomcat 9 setup
      template:
        src= templates/newserver_config.j2 
        dest=/etc/tomcat/java_tomcat9/configuratie/server.xml

@@@START_FILE@@@

- name: Fix Tomcat CVE-2020-1938 on Debian
  hosts: debian_hosts
  become: true

  tasks:
    - name: Update package list
      apt:
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Install tomcat8 and dependencies
      apt:
        name: [tomcat8 tomcat8-common libtomcat7-java tomcat8-docs tomcat8-examples]
        state: present

    - name: Create tomcat service systemd files for tomcat8 and restart it
      become_user: root
      command: systemctl disable tomcat9 && systemctl remove tomcat9 && systemctl daemon-reload
      changed_when: false
      args:
        creates: "{{ systemctl_path }}/tomcat9.service"

    - name: Copy tomcat8 service files
      copy:
        src: /etc/init.d/tomcat8
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/tomcat8.service"
        mode: '0644'
        owner: root
        group: root
        backup: yes

    - name: Systemctl reload for tomcat8 and restart it
      command: systemctl daemon-reload || true && systemctl start tomcat8 && systemctl status tomcat8

    - name: Install OpenSSL
      apt:
        name: openssl
        state: present

    - name: Update security policy for APR andTomcat connector
      blockinfile:
        path: /etc/apache2/mods-available/socache_shmcb.conf
        create: yes
        block: |
          SecFilterEngine Off
          SecFilterScanURLOff
          SecFilterSCANURLOff

    - name: Disable APR and Tomcat Connectors in Apache2
      file:
        path: /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf
        state: present
       backup: yes
      blockinfile:
        path: /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/000-default.conf
        Create: yes
        block: |
          # Exclude Tomcat Connector below
          <Location /manager/>
             Order deny,allow
             Allow from all
          </Location>
          # Include Tomcat Connector below
          <Location />
            Order allow,deny
           Allow from all
          </Location>

@@@END_FILE@@@

@@@START_FILE@@@

# Default policy is DENY
DEFINE MARK "Inside" 0
DEFINE MARK "DMZ" 1
DEFINE MARK "Internet" 2
DEFINE MARK "Management" 3

# Mark internal clients
-A INPUT -s 10.0.0.0/16 -j MARK --set-mark "Inside"

# Allow established connections
-A INPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

# Block all incoming traffic by default
-A INPUT -m mark !--match-set Inside 0 -j DROP

# Accept incoming traffic for the firewall itself from management subnet
-A INPUT -s 10.1.0.0/24 -dport 22,3389 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

# Allow Internal to DMZ, but only specific servers
-A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -d 172.16.20.{10,11} -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -s 10.0.0.0/16 -d 172.16.20.50 -j ACCEPT

# Allow DMZ to the internet, EXCEPT webservers and application proxy
-A FORWARD -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -m mark !--match-set Internet -j DROP
-A FORWARD -s 172.16.20.100 -m state --state NEW -dport 80,443 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -s 172.16.20.{10,11} -m state --state NEW -dport 80,443 -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -m mark "DMZ" -j ACCEPT

# Block DMZ to internal and management network
-A FORWARD -s 172.16.20.0/24 ! -d 172.16.20.{100,50} -m mark !--match-set Inside -j DROP
-A FORWARD -s 172.16.20.0/24 -d 10.1.0.0/24 -j DROP

# Allow internal clients to access the applicationproxy for internet access
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -m multiport --sports 80,443 -m mark "Inside" -d 172.16.20.50 -j ACCEPT

@@@END_FILE@@@
